remarks: Rarely available at The Hayes House! This beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence offers over 1,500 sq. ft. of elegant living in one of Stamford's premier full-service condominium communities. A thoughtfully designed floor plan showcases a grand, sun-filled living room, formal dining area, and a spacious galley kitchen with stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, and a charming breakfast area. Beautifully preserved parquet hardwood floors in exceptional condition add timeless character and warmth throughout the home. The expansive primary suite features a renovated en-suite bath and generous closet space, while two additional oversized bedrooms provide exceptional flexibility for guests, family, or a home office. Both bathrooms have been tastefully renovated, and additional highlights include multiple walk-in closets, an inviting foyer, updated lighting, and a private screened balcony-perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation. Residents enjoy exceptional amenities including 24-hour doorman and security, concierge service, fitness center, community room, bike storage, private storage, on-site superintendent, guest parking, and reserved garage parking. Heat, hot water, and central air are included, offering outstanding value and convenience. Ideally located just minutes from Downtown Stamford, Metro-North, shopping, dining, parks, and major highways, this is a rare opportunity to lease one of Stamford's most desirable full-service residences.
